review: 208.2a-1: variant opponent_swamp changed two facts (added B's Swamp, restated A's) and left the outcome identical to the base; replaced by swamp_controlled_by_b, which moves one Swamp to B and makes Nightmare 1/1.

208.2b-1: countered variant changed two facts (Counterspell and A not casting Shock) and did not show the rule's off-battlefield clause; delta is now Counterspell alone and expected records the 0/0 in the graveyard.

208.4b-1: copy variant's delta also restated that Giant Growth is not cast (already true of the base) and left the copy unreachable; delta now names only the earlier copy activation, and the exiled Juggernaut is placed in A's exile.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated: every Forge effect that makes a permanent a creature also sets its power and toughness (animation effects, Opalescence-style effects, crew and manifest all supply values), so a creature with no value for power or toughness cannot be reached in a two-player Forge game

scenarios.title: A characteristic-defining ability sets power and toughness from the board

setup.notes: Nightmare's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Swamps its controller controls.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Nightmare, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: two_swamps
variants.expected: Nightmare is a 2/2 (two Swamps). Shock deals 2 damage and Nightmare moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: three_swamps
variants.expected: Nightmare is a 3/3. Shock deals 2 damage and Nightmare stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: swamp_controlled_by_b
variants.delta: B controls one of the two Swamps instead of A.
variants.expected: Nightmare is a 1/1 (one Swamp under A's control). Shock deals 2 damage and Nightmare moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

scenarios.title: A creature that enters as one of several P/T values has the chosen values
decisions: A casts Aquamorph Entity, tapping four Islands.
B passes priority; Aquamorph Entity resolves.
As it enters, A chooses to make it 5/1.
A casts Shock targeting Aquamorph Entity, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: chosen_5_1
variants.expected: Aquamorph Entity enters as a 5/1. Shock deals 2 damage and it moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: chosen_1_5
variants.expected: Aquamorph Entity enters as a 1/5. Shock deals 2 damage and it stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds to Aquamorph Entity with Counterspell, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Aquamorph Entity is countered and moves to A's graveyard without entering, so no P/T choice is made; in the graveyard its power and toughness are each 0. Shock is not cast at it, since it is no longer on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: An uncrewed Vehicle has no power or toughness on the battlefield

setup.notes: Smuggler's Copter has 3/3 printed on it.

decisions: No actions are taken; the continuous state is read with the Copter uncrewed.

variants.label: uncrewed
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter is an artifact, not a creature, and has no power or toughness.

variants.label: crewed
variants.delta: A has crewed the Copter with Grizzly Bears and the crew ability has resolved.
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter is an artifact creature with power 3 and toughness 3 until end of turn.

variants.label: in_graveyard
variants.delta: Smuggler's Copter is in A's graveyard instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter in the graveyard has its printed power 3 and toughness 3.

scenarios.forge_notes: The graveyard variant moves the Copter, and Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield; the crewed variant adds the crew activation to the decisions.

scenarios.title: A pump aimed at a Vehicle before it is a creature applies once it becomes one

setup.notes: Veteran Motorist: whenever it crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

decisions: A activates Smuggler's Copter's crew ability, tapping Veteran Motorist.
Veteran Motorist's crew trigger goes on the stack above the crew ability.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves while the Copter is not yet a creature.
Both players pass; the crew ability resolves.

variants.label: motorist_crews
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter becomes an artifact creature and is a 4/4 until end of turn (printed 3/3 plus the +1/+1 created while it was not a creature).

variants.label: bears_crew
variants.delta: A taps Grizzly Bears to crew instead of Veteran Motorist.
variants.expected: No crew trigger occurs. Smuggler's Copter becomes an artifact creature and is a 3/3 until end of turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Pump on a noncreature Vehicle is expected to persist until it becomes a creature; verify the Copter shows 4/4.

scenarios.title: A base-power check ignores pumps and counts the copied base value

setup.notes: Curie: whenever it deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its base power. Curie is a 1/3.

decisions: A declares Curie, Emergent Intelligence as an attacker against B.

variants.label: unmodified
variants.expected: Curie deals 1 damage; B is at 19. A draws 1 card, Curie's base power.

variants.label: pumped
variants.delta: After blockers, A casts Giant Growth targeting Curie, tapping Forest.
variants.expected: Curie is 4/6 and deals 4 damage; B is at 16. A still draws only 1 card, because the +3/+3 does not change base power.

variants.label: copy_of_juggernaut
variants.delta: Earlier this turn A activated Curie's copy ability, exiling a Juggernaut A controlled, so Curie is a copy of Juggernaut with Curie's draw trigger.
variants.expected: Curie, a 5/3 Juggernaut, deals 5 damage; B is at 15. A draws 5 cards, the copied base power.

scenarios.forge_notes: The copy variant starts from Curie already a copy of Juggernaut (Forge's Clone with AddTriggers keeps the draw trigger, and Count$CardBasePower reads the copied base power); the base setup's exile holds the Juggernaut that activation exiled.
